mae: Quick heads-up — bringing up lynx42k-int4 (30k context). After a long prefill + an induced KV eviction the model drifts: outputs change non-deterministically and eval NLL jumps.

sachin: Hmm, where's the repro?

mae: Small reproducer below, deterministic seed. Happens when prefill > ~28k and we trigger a shard eviction during continuation.

mae: Repro command:
```bash
mk-eval-runner --model lynx42k-int4 --seed 42 --prompt-file tests/longprime.txt --max-tokens 256 --prefill 30000 --trigger-evict true
```

mae: Minimal log excerpt from the run: 
```text
[2026-03-22 12:34:56] kv_index=65536 ropescale=1.00012
[2026-03-22 12:34:56] kv_index=65537 ropescale=0.99978  <-- mismatch observed immediately after eviction/restore
[2026-03-22 12:34:57] token_diff_detected=1.43e-02 nll_delta=+14.2%
```

sachin: I can repro locally with the sim harness. Looks like the rotary scale gets recomputed per-shard and we lose continuity when the cache stitching logic reindexes keys.

oliver: Confirmed on a CPU simulated pass — bisect points at int4 kernel v3.2 (the fused ropescale path). int8 path doesn't show the shift.

mae: Additional observation: if we disable prefix caching the drift disappears, so it's strongly tied to the cache stitch/restore path rather than the attention math itself.

infra-bot: deploy/canary lynx42k-int4 reported anomaly: regen drift exceeded threshold at 2026-03-22T12:45:10. Canary halted.

mae: I ran the eval harness against our longbench set (prime_set_v7) — with caching enabled NLL +12–15%, without caching NLL baseline.

oliver: Hypothesis: per-shard floating point quantization + integer scale rounding causes slightly different ropescale when we recompute using the shard offset. Stitching assumes identical ropescale across boundaries.

mae: Proposed quick fix: normalize ropescale on restore by computing a reference scale from the first shard and applying a multiplicative correction to subsequent shards during stitch. Also add an assert in unit tests to catch drift > 1e-4.

sachin: I put up a tiny patch in PR #1234 that applies the normalization and adds a test. Patch notes: "normalize rotary scale on kv_restore to preserve continuity across shard boundaries (int4 path)".

mae: Can we run a smoke benchmark (5 seeds) patched vs unpatched on g4dn? If good, we should backport to dedicated and hold host roll until QA passes.

oliver: I'll run a quick smoke now. Command I'm using:
```bash
./scripts/run_longbench.sh lynx42k-int4 patched --seeds 42 43 44 45 46 --prefill 32000 --out /tmp/lynx-smoke-patched
```

mae: Thanks. If oliver sees regressions go ahead and notify @sachin and tag the canary.

sachin: Also adding a unit reproducer to tests/unit/test_kvcache_ropescale.py that asserts ropescale continuity after eviction/restore for int4 and int8.

mae: Nice. After smoke I'll run our full eval (20 seeds) on the dedicated stage cluster.

deploy-bot: Canary create request queued for lynx42k-int4 with patch PR #1234.

mae: Appreciate it — ping me with the smoke logs. :thumbsup:

oliver: quick note — initial smoke shows the patched run has ropescale diffs within 2e-5 and NLL drop back to baseline. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-ci/lynx-smoke/1766000000/

mae: Excellent, thanks. Next steps: (1) finish full eval, (2) backport to dedicated/runtime, (3) add integration test to onboarding pipeline so we fail on >1% regen drift after prefill+evict.

sachin: Will do.

mae: closing loop once full eval done.
